entities.name: Donald Eugene Chambers
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Donald Eugene Chambers was an American Marine, outlaw biker, and founder of the Bandidos Motorcycle Club. In 1972, Chambers was convicted of murdering two drug dealers and served a life sentence until his parole in 1983.
